anchor: Plan v29 Phase 1.5 — full 196-country CEP. Top 50 are Tier A (hand-anchored). Remaining ~146 are Tier B/C via regional-cluster + GDP-tier interpolation from Tier A anchors. Universal terms only (R-002). Every field is internal; never named in user-visible copy.
convention: All monetary fields in USD (2024 reference year). Percentages stored as decimals where pct sits in the field name (vat_gst_standard_pct = 0.20 means 20%). employer_social_pct etc. stored as decimals. Quality flags A/B/C/D track the research depth of each field.
